name: Solar Home Oklahoma Electric
old_description: Solar Home Oklahoma Electric provides custom residential and commercial installation solutions designed to power your life and business with sustainable energy. By combining localized incentives to maximize your upfront savings with proactive maintenance programs that ensure long-term, cost-effective performance, we make the transition to solar both seamless and worry-free. Experience the peace of mind that comes with local expertise and a system built to run problem-free for years to come.
about:
Solar Home Oklahoma Electric operates from Moore, Oklahoma, serving residential and commercial customers across the state with solar energy installation and support services. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure in the available materials.

The firm provides end-to-end solar solutions including custom system design, panel installation, routine maintenance, real-time performance monitoring, and financing consultation. Its service portfolio covers both rooftop and ground-mount arrays, with proactive checkup programs intended to maintain long-term system output. No facility size, headcount, or annual installation volume is published.

Customers include Oklahoma homeowners seeking to reduce electricity bills and businesses pursuing sustainability goals. The company references localized incentive programs to improve project economics and positions itself as a local expert for the Oklahoma market.

The company emphasizes a seamless transition to solar through localized incentive expertise, proactive maintenance programs, real-time monitoring, and flexible financing options, aiming to deliver worry-free, cost-effective energy independence.
